note: Resolved by this unit. The entry recorded the INT8 hybrid-layout 500 as blocked on a release decision; the defect is now fixed. Root cause: packed_decode_max_rows was assigned the declared direct width before the layer layout was computed and never revisited, so a hybrid INT8/BF16 session advertised width 4 while its BF16-prefix layers have no retained planes. Added _gguf_packed_decode_max_rows in qwen35_gguf_runner.py to cap the width at one row for a hybrid layout, which routes through the existing NotImplementedError refusal that step_batch_native already turns into a serialized fallback. Verified: scripts/int8_mtp_server_lifecycle_gate.py passes 7/7 on the default hybrid layout, and the probe matrix that previously produced four 500s now returns 200 for every case with zero REQUEST_FAILED.

Resolved by the v0.6.1 release. The entry recorded that a publication verification found no v0.7.0 on PyPI or GitHub, because the release had deliberately stopped before the tag. The lead then set the release to v0.6.1, which was published and verified end to end: worklog/entries/20260922T100731.111308Z-lhl-v061-published-1cd36b.md records PyPI at 0.6.1, workflow run 35713524161 success, and a uvx install from PyPI reporting 0.6.1. The v0.7.0 number in this entry is superseded, not outstanding.
